name: Tennessee
standard: WCAG 2.1 AA plus Revised Section 508 (STS ADA Digital Accessibility Initiative; TN.gov accessibility statement)

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web/mobile rule, 2024; compliance dates extended by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: Requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA, with compliance dates now 2027-04-26 (population 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: STS RFI 31701-03579 (ADA Digital Accessibility Initiative scope)

applies_to: Executive branch agencies, with the program run for the 23 agencies under Strategic Technology Solutions consolidated support; public and employee-facing digital content. Local governments via the ADA Title II floor.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II floor: state government and local entities with population 50,000+ must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by the 2026 DOJ IFR).
ADA Title II floor: local entities under 50,000 population and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26).

requires: Agency inventory of in-scope web and mobile applications (targeted 2024-10-31)
Multi-year remediation to WCAG 2.1 AA under the STS ADA Program
Public barrier-reporting path with URL, barrier description and requested format
mobile: explicit — the STS program names mobile apps such as MyTN.
procurement: No published statewide accessibility contract clause found.
enforcement: Reports to Accessibility@tn.gov or Department of Disability and Aging (Nashville); ADA Title II complaints to US DOJ.
notes: No TN statute or formal STS policy document naming the standard was found; the program is described in an RFI. The RFI's 2026-04-24 date predates the DOJ extension.
